name: 4a-mods
description: 4A-Mods: Claude Code mods by 4AM. Cache Keeper shows costs as plan-limit percent instead of dollars; Toggles switches plugins, skills and MCP servers and shows what each costs in context; Plan Keeper ticks plan files from the task list.

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps a big chat's prompt cache warm, warns before an expensive cold restart, shows every local chat on one board (/board), and hands a chat off to a fresh one (/handoff)

plugins.name: plugin-toggles
plugins.description: One pane (/toggles) to switch skills On, Name, User or Off, plugins and MCP servers On or Off, see what each costs in context, and save the set as a profile

plugins.name: plan-keeper
plugins.description: Ticks a plan file's checkbox items once the task-list step of the same text is done, and lists the open items when a chat starts or clears
